issues.concern: The gloss combines two distinct meanings of the headword, which can be confusing for learners. The headword has two distinct senses, one for 'triplets' and one for 'three-year-old child'. The current gloss presents them as if they are a single, combined meaning or closely related, rather than separate senses.
issues.suggestion: Separate the gloss into two distinct parts, reflecting the two senses. For example: 'triplets; three-year-old child (in proverbs)' or 'triplets; (archaic) three-year-old child'.
